ordered_operations: load the exact full-deck Oracle specifications
cast Opt through the shared ActionBroker
cast Dualcaster Mage through the shared ActionBroker with an explicit ETB target handle
resolve the Dualcaster ETB trigger and copied spell
cast Twinflame through the shared ActionBroker targeting two controlled creatures
preconditions: The full-deck package supplies Opt, Dualcaster Mage, Twinflame, Malcolm, and Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
The acting policy receives only observations and opaque broker action handles.
required_assertions: the Dualcaster cast action exposes the original Opt spell only through an opaque trigger target handle
Twinflame token copies are synthetic and cease after delayed exile

plain_english: The exact deck's Opt, Dualcaster Mage, and Twinflame are selected and cast through the same opaque ActionBroker used by Phase B policy code.
Dualcaster's ETB target is represented to policy by an opaque handle, and the resulting spell copy has no physical-card component and was not cast.
Twinflame creates synthetic token copies through the broker path and the delayed triggers exile those copies at the next end step.
title: Dualcaster and Twinflame preserve copied-spell-not-cast identity through the Phase B broker
